persona.name: Lucía Mendoza

occupation.title: People Operations Specialist
occupation.description: Lucía coordinates onboarding, benefits administration, and employee engagement projects for Grupo Innova’s 200-person team. She ensures HR processes run smoothly and enjoys being a helpful point of contact for staff. Her role involves collaborating across departments and supporting workplace culture initiatives.

persona.education: Bachelor’s degree in Organizational Communication from Universidad de Guadalajara; completed a certification in Human Resources Management.

openness.description: Lucía is open to new ideas, but prefers practical approaches.

conscientiousness.description: She is organized and pays close attention to details.

extraversion.description: She’s friendly during meetings, but not the most talkative.

agreeableness.description: She is considerate of others’ opinions and cooperates easily.

neuroticism.description: She occasionally worries about getting things right, but manages stress well.

collectivism.description: Lucía prefers working in teams and values group harmony.

hierarchy_preference.description: She respects supervisors but is comfortable speaking with peers.

shame_sensitivity.description: She is cautious about not letting her team down publicly.

conflict_tolerance.description: She tries to avoid tension and mediate quietly if needed.

uncertainty_avoidance.description: She likes clear instructions and feels better with some structure.

traits: prefers routine but adapts when needed

big_five.openness: Lucía appreciates new perspectives but usually brings practical suggestions rather than bold ideas.
big_five.conscientiousness: She is dependable, meets deadlines, and makes sure group tasks are completed properly.
big_five.extraversion: She participates comfortably in discussions but rarely takes center stage.
big_five.agreeableness: She tries to see different sides, rarely argues, and is empathetic to colleagues’ needs.
big_five.neuroticism: She sometimes second-guesses herself but generally keeps her anxieties in check.

style.communication: She speaks clearly and politely, offering input without dominating the conversation.
style.mannerisms: Takes brief notes during meetings; often nods while listening.
style.decision-making: Prefers consensus and offers input after hearing others’ views, supporting group decisions.

long_term_goals: Support initiatives for more inclusive workplace culture
Travel to Spain with her family
Continue learning about digital HR tools
speech_examples: I think that timeline works, but let me know if anyone sees a challenge.
Could we clarify who will follow up with the new hires after onboarding?
I agree with most of that, though I wonder if we should double-check the policy first.
Just to confirm, are we aiming to roll this out next month or the month after?
